narratives.Description: Per-host native command/prompt emitters for epic #55 Wave 1-2. Consume packages/core slash generator IR from #3052 without duplicating the L2 name table. Emit host-specific file layouts for enabled formats (claude, cursor, codex, grok as formats allow).
narratives.Overview:
## Parent

Epic **#55** — native agent slash-command registration (multi-host).

## Summary

**Per-host emitters** that map the shared thin-wrapper IR to each supported host’s native command/prompt/workflow file format and paths.

## Depends on

- Generator core (child B)
- Name/product set (child A)

## Scope

- Emitters for hosts Directive already treats as first-class for deposit/hooks where formats are known (expand as matrix grows)
- Correct paths per host (e.g. Claude commands, Copilot prompts, Cursor/Gemini/Codex as applicable)
- Same external command names across hosts; no host-specific long prose
- Engineering may land **format-by-format** in stacked PRs under this child (or tiny follow-ups), but product completeness is “all **enabled** hosts in policy,” not “one host only”

## Out of scope

- Choosing exclusive single-host install default (forbidden by #55 multi-host amendment)
- init/update policy wiring (D) — emitters are pure generate-to-path given a host id

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] At least the hosts in the initial enabled matrix have emitters
- [ ] Outputs are thin wrappers only; shared names from A/B
- [ ] Adding a host is an additive emitter, not a redesign of the name table
- [ ] Documented mapping: host id → output directory/file pattern

## Refs

- Parent: #55
- Multi-host amendment on #55
narratives.UserStory: As a multi-host Directive user, I want per-host slash command emitters that consume the shared generator IR, so that each supported agent host gets thin native command files without a second product name table.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Import generateThinWrappers / PRODUCT_COMMANDS from @deftai/directive-core slash module (#3052).
- Implement per-host emitters (claude commands, cursor/codex/grok formats as known).
- Map logical ids to host paths and hyphen filenames (L4).
- Unit tests: emitter output shape, no body inlining, uses shared IR only.
- CHANGELOG Unreleased #3053 Refs #55.
- Out of scope: init/update deposit (#3054), docs dogfood (#3055).

narrative.Acceptance: Given the #3052 generator IR, when an emitter runs, then it does not redefine the L2 product table and produces thin wrappers only.

items.title: Host path layouts for known formats

narrative.Acceptance: Given enabled host formats (at least Claude Code layout), when emit runs, then files land under the host-specific directory with L4 hyphen names.
Given emitter unit tests, when they run, then they assert non-inlining, stable host paths, and count matches product set.
Given CHANGELOG Unreleased, when reviewed, then #3053 and Refs #55 appear.
